thread:
Elaine K.: Quick sync — we need to lock the audit event schema changes for the RBAC + KMS work. Proposal attached: add `audit_version`, `actor_kms_key_id`, `auth_method`; deprecate `legacy_actor_id` and `session_token`. Can we agree on a migration plan?

Devin M.: +1 on `audit_version`. I think we should use a simple integer version in the envelope, not semver, to make runtime checks fast: `audit_version: 2`. Runtime accepts 1..2 and logs if unknown.

Omar R.: Flag: some downstream customers parse by field order and will break if we remove `legacy_actor_id`. We need a compatibility shim (server-side pass-through) for at least one release cycle and a customer opt-in to drop the field.

Elaine K.: Agreed on shim. Plan: write runtime to continue emitting `legacy_actor_id` when `audit_version`==2 for 90 days, with a warn metric. Add a validator that can run in dry-run to detect producers writing v2 without the shim.

Kevin L.: For KMS metadata, the `actor_kms_key_id` will contain GUID-like strings. We should NOT include any secret material (never a key blob). Also, check our PIIscanner rules for new field names.

Devin M.: Working on draft JSON Schema for v2 validator. Quick snippet for discussion:
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "required": ["audit_version","event_type","actor"],
  "properties": {
    "audit_version": {"type":"integer"},
    "actor": {"type":"object"},
    "actor_kms_key_id": {"type":"string"},
    "auth_method": {"type":"string"}
  }
}
```

Maya (Product Ops): We need a customer-facing compatibility doc and a staged timeline. Customers expect 60-90 days heads-up. Can engineering give a canary + broad rollout timeline? Also want a new public field in the change log that spells out deprecated fields.

Elaine K.: Canary: 2 weeks internal; 2 weeks invited customers; full rollout after 60 days. Must include: validator in prod (dry-run), metrics (per-customer warn counts), and a rollback plan that re-enables legacy-only payloads.

Omar R.: About migrations: consider publishing a signed sample of v2 events and a small validation tool (CLI) customers can run against historic exports. That reduces support load. I can own the CLI prototype.

Kevin L.: Storage/backfill note — when we change the envelope shape, we should not rewrite historic events in the cold store. Instead index by `audit_version` and add a view for unified querying. Doing a mass backfill will be expensive and risky.

Devin M.: CI / Test automation: I'll add unit tests for the schema validator and an integration test in canary pipeline. ci-bot — can you add a short pipeline job that runs validator on the canary cluster?

ci-bot: add_job: audit-schema-validator-canary -> status: queued (:hourglass_flowing_sand:)

Elaine K.: Security concerns: verify KMS key ID parsing to avoid leakage of internal IDs in public logs. Also ensure RBAC events include `auth_method` values limited to enumerated set ("password", "oauth", "api_key", "sso") and validate in schema.

Maya (Product Ops): I'll draft the customer communication + migration checklist. Questions for eng: what telemetry will we expose so customers can see their deprecated-field count?

Devin M.: We'll expose a per-tenant metric `audit_deprecated_field_count{tenant=...}` and a daily export CSV in the console for invited customers.

Elaine K.: Action items: 1) Devin: finish JSON Schema & validator (due in 3 business days). 2) Omar: prototype CLI validator and sample v2 events (due EOW). 3) Kevin: confirm storage view approach and PIIscan rule changes (due in 5 days). 4) Maya: customer comms + timeline (due in 2 business days). 5) ci-bot / Eng infra: add canary validator job (when Devin ready).

Omar R.: noted. I'll put a short README with the CLI usage and example outputs.

Kevin L.: I'll review retention and indexing costs but tile this under "no backfill by default".

Devin M.: I'll create a PR: `eng/security/audit-schema/v2` with schema + integration tests and mark draft.

Elaine K.: Great. Last thing — please add a field-level changelog entry we can surface in the Console UI (Maya we can sync on wording). Meeting if any blockers tomorrow 10am.

Maya (Product Ops): syncing on wording tomorrow 10am works for me.

ci-bot: job update: audit-schema-validator-canary -> status: running

Elaine K.: Thanks all. If anyone spots a compliance/legal angle I missed (e.g., export controls on KMS IDs) ping legal and @Maya.
